name: export-controls-agent-mcp
description: MCP server for export-control legal research. Models US EAR jurisdiction (734.4 de minimis, all 13 FDP rules), Part 740 License Exceptions, Part 744 end-use controls, the Commerce Control List and the Consolidated Screening List against dated eCFR snapshots, plus full Korean 대외무역법 text.

scripts.data:rebuild: npm run data:country-groups && npm run data:part740 && npm run data:ccl && npm run data:screening && npm run validate:vocabulary
scripts.validate: npm run validate:vocabulary && npm run validate:fdp
scripts.test: node ./verify/check-textmatch.mjs && node ./verify/check-critical.mjs && node ./verify/check-ccl.mjs && node ./verify/check-task3.mjs && node ./verify/check-task4.mjs && node ./verify/check-screening.mjs && node ./verify/check-jurisdiction.mjs && node ./verify/check-coverage-claims.mjs
